mainEntity.name: Do we need an editor or a production team?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. One person who can write an offer can run it. There is no timeline, no keyframes and no render queue to manage.

mainEntity.name: Where do the vehicle images come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yours. We do not supply or license vehicle imagery, and we do not pull from third-party inventory feeds. You upload the photos already on your lot.

mainEntity.name: Can we change a price after publishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Change the field and only the affected versions update. You do not re-render the set.

mainEntity.name: What sizes and languages do we get?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every size is cropped from a single render rather than rendered separately, which is what keeps the cost flat as the version count grows.
The intent is that output belongs to the dealership.
